results.evidence: During August 2025, Quest Diagnostics and Corewell Health signed a definitive agreement to form a new entity to perform laboratory testing in Michigan via a new laboratory facility. The transaction was completed in January 2026. Quest obtained a controlling 51% interest in the entity and Corewell Health retained 49%. Total purchase consideration was $38 million in cash plus a $253 million non-controlling interest valuation.

results.evidence: Capital expenditures of $252 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and $225 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025. The Company is engaged in Project Nova, a multi-year project to modernize Order to Cash business processes and information technology infrastructure, expected to be completed in 2031 to 2032. Additionally, the Company is building a new laboratory facility in Michigan in partnership with Corewell Health, expected to be operational during 2027.

eventInstances.description: Project Nova - multi-year modernization of Order to Cash business processes and IT infrastructure
eventInstances.sourceLine: In February 2025, we committed to a multi-year project ("Project Nova") to modernize our "Order to Cash" business processes, which includes the related information technology infrastructure and underlying enabling technologies.

eventInstances.description: New laboratory facility in Michigan operational
eventInstances.sourceLine: Under the terms of the transaction, the Company and Corewell Health are continuing to serve providers and patients in Michigan from their existing patient service centers (which are operated by the newly formed entity) and their existing laboratories until a new laboratory is operational during 2027.

results.evidence: As of June 30, 2026, there were no outstanding borrowings under either the $600 million Secured Receivables Credit Facility or the $750 million Senior Unsecured Revolving Credit Facility. Both facilities had full capacity available.

On February 10, 2026, Quest Diagnostics announced a 7.5% increase in its quarterly dividend from $0.80 per share to $0.86 per share, effective with the dividend payable on April 20, 2026. This represents the 15th dividend increase since the beginning of 2012. Additionally, the Board authorized an additional $1 billion share repurchase program.

results.evidence: No asset sales or divestitures are disclosed in the filings. The company acquired select clinical testing and dialysis-related water testing assets from Fresenius Medical Care's Spectra Laboratories in 2025, but this is an acquisition, not a sale.

The filings do not disclose foreign revenue as a separate segment or provide geographic revenue breakdown. While the company mentions serving customers globally and having operations in selected locations outside the United States, no specific foreign revenue figures or growth trends are provided.

A new entity was formed in January 2026 as a joint venture between Quest Diagnostics (51% ownership) and Corewell Health (49% ownership) to perform laboratory testing in Michigan. The entity is consolidated in Quest's financial statements.

results.evidence: No IPO or secondary equity offering is disclosed. The company is an established public company with no equity issuance activity reported in the filings.

Quest Diagnostics maintains fixed-to-variable interest rate swap agreements on $1,800 million of notional debt as of June 30, 2026. These swaps convert fixed-rate senior notes into variable-rate debt with rates ranging from SOFR minus 1.36% to SOFR plus 2.48%. The swapped instruments include the 5.00% Senior Notes due December 2034 ($850 million notional), 2.80% Senior Notes due June 2031 ($550 million notional), and 6.40% Senior Notes due November 2033 ($400 million notional).
